Personal Account Generalist Raters (Mobile)

Posted 2026-10-22
View application options
Work Type
Remote
Location
United States
Compensation
$25/hr

About this opportunity

Overview

We are sourcing contractors for a mobile AI evaluation project focused on improving how AI understands personal context and delivers relevant, personalized responses.

You will review AI-generated outputs using selected data from G-Suite apps, along with relevant content from Google Messages and device SMS, and provide ratings and feedback to help assess the accuracy, relevance, and quality of AI personalization in real-world scenarios.

What You'll Do

  • Review AI-generated prompts and responses in English.
  • Evaluate responses for relevance, accuracy, helpfulness, and personalization.
  • Assess how well AI understands everyday context, preferences, relationships, routines, and experiences.
  • Provide clear ratings, explanations, and feedback.
  • Follow project guidelines and maintain a high level of consistency.

Requirements

  • Primary Google Pixel 8 or newer device.
  • Android 17 or higher.
  • Regular use of the Google Messages app for personal SMS/RCS conversations.
  • Comfort reviewing AI content in English.
  • Ability to commit to either 40 hours per week or 20 hours per week with 4 hours PST overlap.

Project Details

  • Contractor assignment.
  • Engagement length: 16 weeks.
  • Start date: Oct 26.
  • Rate: $25/hr.
  • Interview process includes an ICF step and profile review.

Skills & expertise

AI evaluation English language comprehension Content rating Personalization assessment Mobile device usage Android Google Messages
